$doc: The kernel's own system calls, beside xpute's in the same stream (spec/xpute/ipc/
sys.json, pxl-kernel host.rs, apps/web/src/kernel/host.ts), and the range and the
files it keeps them in.
The stream's range, laid out by the kernel's map.
The range's size. A record names what it moves rather than carrying it, so
a turn's records are words, and a text's bytes the most of them.
The kernel's calls, each with xpute's PROGRAM bit; a record's call, then its arguments.
weight, px (f32 bits), max width (f32 bits, 0 for one line), at, lines, then the
text's bytes: the text in the platform's own family at the weight and size, broken
into lines no wider than the width where it can be; at `at`, how many lines, then
a line's end (a byte offset) and its width (f32) apiece, `lines` of them at most
fd, image: the file opened as `fd` decoded where the device is and held for the
renderer as `image`, a handle the kernel issued; answered by IMAGE_DECODED. The
host takes the file's bytes when it runs this, so the kernel may close `fd` in the
same turn.
weight, px (f32 bits), color (0xRRGGBBAA), at, width, height, x (f32 bits), then
the text's bytes: one line drawn in the platform's own family, starting at x with
the middle of its em box on the middle row, into `width` by `height` pixels at
`at`, RGBA a byte a channel, top row first, alpha not premultiplied
The roots the kernel opens files below (xpute's OPENAT). Below STORAGE a root is a
bake, numbered by its kind (pxl-spec bake/published.spec.rs), and a path is an object's
name in it.
The platform's storage; a path is a key (`STORAGE_KEYS`).
The shipped assets; a path is a load's number in decimal (io/load.rs).
What the platform's storage keeps, by `STORAGE_KEYS`' order.
The keys, in `storage`'s order. The objects' carries the encoding's version: a blob
of an older one is not read, so bump it whenever a change makes an older entry
mean something other than it meant when it was written (layer/object/store.rs).
